instruction: Create a new Piano score named "Piano_Violin", open the Instruments dialog, add a Violin staff and place it above the Piano staff, then save as ~/Documents/piano_violin.mscx

verification.condition: Check if ~/Documents/piano_violin.mscx exists and its text content contains "instrument-name>Violin" before "instrument-name>Piano"
verification.expected_result: The .mscx file lists two instruments with Violin appearing before Piano
